rci5_n.detail: Computed from Table S1: CNP HC n=110 + COBRE HC n=73 + DIRECT HC n=251 = 434. Note: the abstract states 255 HCs from three datasets, which is arithmetically inconsistent with Table S1 values (DIRECT HC alone is 251). The Table S1 breakdown is used here as it provides detailed, internally consistent per-dataset counts. The abstract value (255) is likely a reporting error.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "HC (n = 110)" [CNP discovery]; "HC (n = 73)" [COBRE validation 1]; "HC (N=251)" [DIRECT validation 2]; abstract: "255 healthy controls (HCs) from three distinct datasets"
rci5_n.location: Fang2024_sup.docx.md: Table S1, L35; Fang2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L42

rci6_sex.detail: Computed from Table S1 sex percentages and Ns: CNP HC male 78.38% of n=110 → 86M / 24F; COBRE HC male 68.49% of n=73 → 50M / 23F; DIRECT HC male 34.66% of n=251 → 87M / 164F. Pooled: male n=223 (51.4%), female n=211 (48.6%). Female_n estimated as total N minus computed male_n within each dataset; minor rounding applied.

rci7_age.detail: Weighted mean computed from Table S1: (110×31.26 + 73×36.07 + 251×39.64) / 434 = 16021.35 / 434 = 36.92 years. Pooled SD computed as sqrt(((110-1)×8.66² + (73-1)×13.08² + (251-1)×15.87²) / (434-3)) = sqrt(83457.4 / 431) = 13.92 years. Age range (min/max) not reported for the normative HC sample. Age in years.
